description: This file is a script for detecting specific usage of os.tmpdir() and tmpdir() functions within other source files. It appears tailored for runtime checks related to messaging channel sources and includes functions for analyzing TypeScript source code to find specific function call patterns, as well as a main function to run the analysis with configured parameters.

methods.name: collectOsTmpdirImports
methods.description: Analyzes a TypeScript source file to identify import statements that bring in the 'os' module or its namespace, and specifically identifies imports for 'tmpdir'.

methods.name: findMessagingTmpdirCallLines
methods.description: Parses source code to locate call sites of os.tmpdir() or tmpdir() functions, returning their line information.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function; it runs the callsite guard analysis with specified parameters against designated source root directories.
